page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. It features 16 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, supported by 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per core ratio. The CPU includes 48 MB of L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Vector Neural Network Instructions (VNNI) alongside hardware-accelerated cryptography via AES and SHA extensions. The instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average tier across multiple workloads. It achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1885.18 and a multi-core score of 15531.0, complemented by a Geekbench multi-core score of 9288.0. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only cached small block bandwidth of 846.07 GB/sec and an uncached large block write speed of 56.5 GB/sec. In application-specific tests, the instance demonstrates a static web serving throughput of 20.56 GB/sec, a Redis SET performance of 15.7 million operations per second, and a Passmark database operations score of 7516.85.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a compute-optimized resource, offering high processing density relative to its memory footprint. This configuration is cost-efficient for CPU-bound tasks that do not require massive memory allocations or local NVMe storage, though the lack of local disks requires network storage considerations. It is suitable for workloads such as web serving, software compilation, database operations, and multi-threaded decompression tasks.
